notes: Fixed RGB looking like the plain pink theme: plain RGB cycles the visible colours again, so buttons, borders, rings and highlights sweep through the rainbow with the glow — that is the whole point of "RGB (animated)". RGB+ keeps its steady accents (that is what RGB+ is for) and animates the glow overlays instead

RGB no longer opens on red and green: the cycle now starts exactly on the theme’s own pink and blue and sweeps away from there, holding the same 120° gap the two accents have always had. Every start and restart — switching to RGB, changing the glow speed or the refresh rate — used to snap the accents to pure red with a green second accent that matched nothing on screen, which is the "the colour is completely off" you reported
The hue cycle is still freeze-proof: it keeps moving even if the tab-icon redraw fails, which is what used to stick RGB on one colour for the rest of the session and stop it cycling
